Read this in celebration of Independence Day (for the first time actually). Really liked it. Anybody wanna discuss or recommend similar must-reads?

If you liked Fahrenheit 451, I would strongly recommend Brave New World and the obvious 1984. Both books are dystopian, but two very different visions of the future; one was ruled by ignorance and willful bliss, and the other by fear. Also, both start out pretty slow, but get extremely interesting, so I would suggest just baring it through the beginnings.

If you liked it, I would consider reading some more of Bradbury's works. The Martian Chronicles is his best, in my opinion. Try some of the short stories as well.

For the actual book, I love it. Did you feel more like it was about censorship or the effects of mass media/technology? The former is taught about more, although I feel like the second was more the point of the book. Message aside, I love Bradbury's metaphors, and overall it was a great book.
